svg.title: BFF architecture: the browser never sees tokens
svg.desc: The browser SPA talks only to the gateway with a session cookie. The gateway runs the authorization code flow with PKCE against Keycloak, keeps the tokens in a Redis session, and relays the access token to the API, which verifies it against Keycloak's keys.

text.tspan: BFF architecture: the browser never sees tokens
The browser holds only an opaque session cookie. Tokens live in Redis and never leave the server side.
